title: incident2chaos: chaos experiments derived from real cloud incident reports
description: A command line tool that turns a post-incident report, coded under a published codebook of 13 trigger codes and 20 fault classes, into Chaos Mesh or LitmusChaos experiments marked as direct injections, approximations or not injectable. It ships with the coded corpus of 437 public cloud post-incident reports (Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, GitHub, 2020 to 2026) and a coverage command that reruns the measurement of the study “Which Real Cloud Failures Can Chaos Tools Inject? A Mapping Study of 437 Public Post-Incident Reports and Two Fault Catalogs”. No report text is redistributed.
